name: OpenAI API
authNotes: Uses an API key from platform.openai.com with API billing. A ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription does not include API access, and OpenAI's "Sign in with ChatGPT" is only offered for OpenAI's own apps (ChatGPT, Codex), so Theologians cannot use your ChatGPT subscription.

name: Anthropic API
authNotes: Uses an API key from the Claude Console with API billing. Anthropic's documentation states that third-party apps may not offer claude.ai login or use Claude Free/Pro/Max subscription credentials, so a Claude subscription cannot be used here.

name: Google Gemini API
summary: Gemini API via generateContent (free tier with limits, or paid).
authNotes: Uses an API key from Google AI Studio. Google AI Pro/Ultra subscriptions don't provide API keys, and Google's terms prohibit using Gemini CLI's Google sign-in from other software. Note: on the free tier Google may use prompts to improve its products; check the Gemini API terms.
modelNotes: Google now recommends its newer Interactions API; Theologians uses generateContent, which Google labels legacy but fully supported, because it is stateless (nothing stored server-side by the app's requests).

name: ALCF Inference (Argonne)
summary: Argonne's OpenAI-compatible inference gateway (Sophia vLLM; Metis and Minerva have their own base URLs).
authNotes: Requires ALCF/Globus access. Run ALCF's official helper once in a terminal: `python inference_auth_token.py authenticate`. Theologians then runs `get_access_token`, which refreshes the 48-hour access token automatically. ALCF requires re-authentication every 30 days (`authenticate --force`); when that happens Theologians shows a reconnect message. You can also paste a token instead (it expires after 48 hours).
modelNotes: Other clusters: Metis `https://inference-api.alcf.anl.gov/resource_server/metis/api/v1`, Minerva `https://inference-api.alcf.anl.gov/resource_server/minerva/api/v1`. ALCF disables Responses API streaming on shared endpoints, so this preset uses Chat Completions. Only enable tools for models ALCF marks as tool-calling capable.

name: Ollama (local)
summary: Open-weight models running on this computer through Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API.
authNotes: No credentials. Conversations stay on this computer.

name: LM Studio (local)
summary: Open-weight models running on this computer through LM Studio's local server.
authNotes: No credentials. Conversations stay on this computer.

name: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
summary: Any server that implements the OpenAI Chat Completions API (vLLM, institutional gateways, proxies).
authNotes: Enter the base URL ending in /v1 and the key or token the server expects. Capabilities vary by server; set them per model.
